text:
Sam W: Hey team — got a customer SQ asking for: 1) evidence we redact PII from application logs, 2) retention period and deletion proof, 3) who has KMS key access, and 4) full subprocessors list. Need quick answers for the form.
Devon I: quick notes — app logs are routed to our central log pipeline, we run a redaction pass (regex + rule engine) before indexing. We also redact user_text fields at ingestion for flagged PII.
Priya K: timeline? customer needs completed answers by EOD Friday. can we put something draftable together today?
Sam W: For the SQ, they want specific artifact links. Devon — can you share the redact rule pointer + an example sanitized log? short snippet is fine.
Devon I: putting together. sample sanitized line: `INFO 2025-11-03 user_login user_id=<redacted> email=<redacted@example.com> action=login` — note we keep hashed ids for tracing. Also retention lifecycle: 90 days raw, 365 days indexed.
Marta L: subprocessors: we need the current approved list from legal registry (we have a contract appendix). I'll attach. ops-bot: uploaded document: https://internal.redwood/registry/subprocessors/current (view-only).
Devon I: KMS access: only infra-kms-admin role and the managed backup-job service account. Key rotation schedule: 90 days. Access justification: used for snapshot encryption only.
Alex R: FYI support engineers have read-only access to indexed logs via RBAC but PII fields are masked by default. Escalation process to unmask requires ticket + sec approval.
Sam W: Great. For the SQ field that asks "evidence", we should provide: link to redact config, sample sanitized log, retention policy doc, KMS key admin list screenshot, subprocessors registry link, and the access approval workflow doc. Anything else?
Priya K: Could we also include a short blurb about audit trails? they often ask if we can prove who viewed/decrypted logs.
Devon I: yes — audit logs in CloudAuth include `kms:Decrypt` and log-access events for the index. retention of audit logs = 365 days.
Marta L: I'll draft the subprocessors blurb and legal will sign off. Sam, can you own consolidating the artifacts into the SQ form?
Sam W: Happy to. I'll assemble links and draft answers. Devon/Marta/Alex please drop final links here before 5pm.
Priya K: noted. ping me once it's uploaded and I'll submit. :thumbsup:
Devon I: added redact rules: https://internal.redwood/docs/log-redaction-config and sample file: https://internal.redwood/samples/sanitized-log-example.txt
Alex R: added RBAC doc: https://internal.redwood/ops/rbac-log-access and the access-approval runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/log-unmask-runbook.md
Marta L: legal appendix PDF: https://internal.redwood/legal/subprocessors-apr-2026.pdf
Sam W: pulled everything into a draft answers doc: https://internal.redwood/sec/sq-responses/everspring-2026-draft (please review).
Priya K: reviewed, left two inline comments about wording. small nit on retention phrasing.
Devon I: updated retention phrasing in policy doc to match wording in draft.
Sam W: thanks — I'll finish and submit once Marta confirms legal language.
Marta L: signed off on subprocessors blurb. go ahead to submit after final pass.
Sam W: submitting now. will paste the submitted artifact link when done.
ops-bot: Submission recorded: SQ form submitted by Sam W at 1987654490. Reference: https://internal.redwood/sec/sq-submissions/everspring-2026
Sam W: done — submission link above. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :party:
